operating_contract.autonomy: Proceed autonomously through technically resolvable repository work after fresh reconciliation. Do not send the owner back into external account setup until the repository gate explicitly earns that human step.
operating_contract.user_facing_rule: No routine narration. Speak only for a genuine human/security/cost/policy gate, unrecoverable error, terminal material result, or continuation boundary.
operating_contract.fresh_reconciliation: Before every meaningful write or merge, fresh-reconcile main, open PRs, relevant branches, changed files, CI and concurrent work.
operating_contract.actions_authority: Normal repository CI, browser acceptance, roadmap-required benchmark workflows, path-scoped validation and technically necessary ordinary reruns are standing-preauthorized by AGENTS.md.
operating_contract.cost_boundary: Hard no-billing-authorization constraint: do not activate or accept any product/subscription whose setup authorizes a payment method to be charged for usage beyond free limits. No paid Cloudflare plan, paid API, paid corpus licence or recurring infrastructure cost is authorized.
operating_contract.external_setup_gate_rule: Every future human provisioning step must terminate as FREE_NO_BILLING_AUTHORIZATION_CONFIRMED, BILLING_OR_OVERAGE_AUTHORIZATION_PRESENT, or AMBIGUOUS. Only the first may proceed.
operating_contract.continuation_rule: At a continuation boundary rotate PREVIOUS/CURRENT in GitHub and keep CURRENT sufficient for a new chat to resume without copy-paste.

corpus_scale_repository.name: STEP_7A_NO_BILLING_AUTH_170K_REBASELINE
instructions: Extend existing benchmark ladder to 170k required and 250k stress while preserving the 84-recipe golden oracle.
Simulate one D1 control/auth/index DB plus approximately eight recipe-body DB shards plus one reserved DB slot.
Enforce <=3.5 GB total at 170k, <=350 MB per database, <=1 MiB per index artifact row, <=256 hydrated candidates, <=16 D1 subqueries per protected request and zero full scans.
Add an app-owned IdentityVerifier/exact-allowlist/session/revocation contract; initial provider candidate Google GIS/OIDC.
Prove protected recipe/index data is never emitted as ordinary public Pages static assets.
Add Worker Free CPU/request-budget proxy and reserve actual production CPU/security behavior for the later canary.
Preserve RecipeSource V2 portability, hard filters, source-rights gates, nutrition separation and incremental validation.
Terminal PASS: NO_BILLING_AUTH_170K_ARCHITECTURE_PASS. Failure must stop before any D1 or auth-provider provisioning.
